[[File:Burn hitsplat.png|left]]
[[File:Eclipse (set effect).gif|thumb|280px|A player triggers the ''Eclipse'' set effect, burning their target.]]
'''Burn''' is a temporary [[status effect]] that causes an entity to lose a set amount of [[hitpoints]] over a period of time. Players or NPCs who are burning will be dealt one hitpoint of damage every four ticks (2.4 seconds). Over the course of the burn, entities will lose 10 hitpoints over 40 ticks (24 seconds), or 5 hitpoints over 20 ticks (12 seconds) in the case of the [[scorching bow]]'s [[special attack]].

Up to 5 separate instances of the burn effect can be inflicted at once; in this case the frequency of damage will remain unchanged at once every four ticks, but each time the entity will take damage equal to the number of burn stacks they currently have. After 5 burn stacks, any further burn instances '''will be discarded'''; the oldest burn instance with the lowest time remaining ''will not be replaced''.

Burn damage is coded as ranged damage, and thus will be reduced by a NPC's damage style reductions if applicable. For example, [[Tekton]] and [[Dusk]] are both immune to ranged attacks, meaning they will not take burn damage. The [[Protect from Missiles]] prayer will not reduce burn damage.

The burn effect is currently only applied by the [[burning claws]] special attack, [[scorching bow]] special attack, [[Arkan blade]] special attack, [[Incendiary cannonball]]s, and with a 20% chance on hits with the [[eclipse atlatl]] when used with the full [[Eclipse Moon armour]] set. The scorching bow special attack only works against demons. [[Fire spells]] apply a burn only when used against the [[Maggot King]].

Certain monsters are immune to burns at or below a certain severity. There are 4 levels of burn severity:
* '''Incendiary''' burns, applied by [[Incendiary cannonball]]s. These burns ignore the targeted monster's burn immunity altogether.
* '''Strong''' burns, sometimes called sunfire burns (inflicted by the Eclipse Moon armour set and the Arkan blade).
* '''Normal''' burns (inflicted by burning claws and scorching bow).
* '''Weak''' burns (currently inaccessible).

For an exhaustive list of monsters that are immune to certain burns, see the pages below:
* [[:Category:Monsters immune to strong burns|Monsters immune to strong burns or lower]]
* [[:Category:Monsters immune to normal burns|Monsters immune to normal burns or lower]]
* [[:Category:Monsters immune to weak burns|Monsters immune to weak burns]]

Note that the burn severity of an attack is not strictly related to the amount of damage it deals over its full duration.

Burn damage can be cleared through use of an [[Ornate rejuvenation pool]], or by entering or leaving a [[player-owned house]].

==Burn by enemies==
Several NPCs in [[The Fractured Archive]] are able to inflict burns onto the player:

*[[The Smorks]]' splattered naphtha tiles will inflict a burn starting at 2 damage if stepped on.
*Blocking a [[Dagon'hai Monk]]s Zamorakian Empowerment will inflict a burn starting at 3 damage.
*[[Xarth]]'s magic attacks in phase 1 will inflict a burn starting at 1 damage, however each subsequent magic attack resets the duration and increases the stack by 1; e.g tanking eight attacks in a row will inflict a burn of 8.
*Xarth's explosions during phase 1 and 2 will inflict a burn starting at 3 damage if the blast is taken, or 1 if another player on the same row/column as them is in front of them and takes the blast.

==Similar mechanics==
Other NPCs can inflict damage over time that are described as burns by game messages, but these mechanics are not true burn effects (many also predate the burn status itself): the [[hitsplat]] uses the regular damage hitsplat rather than the burn hitsplat, and do not stack more than once.
* The fires launched by the [[Alchemical Hydra]] during its flame phase can deal up to 25 damage if hit, then subsequently dealing 5 damage for 5 hits.
* The [[burning orb]] that may appear during the fight with [[Akkha]] periodically deals 5 damage for several hits, and is able to spread to adjacent unaffected players.
* The [[Great Olm]]'s burn attack deals 6 instances of 5 damage at intervals of 8 ticks, lowering combat stats by 2 each time, and is able to spread to adjacent unaffected players.
* The [[Judge of Yama (A Kingdom Divided)|Judge of Yama]]'s [[Fire Wave (Judge of Yama)|fire waves]] deal up to 20 damage if hit, then subsequently deal 1-2 damage for 5 hits.
